name: Pawcturne
source:
One night, a strange, wobbly cat calls at your door. Now, this is all a dream, so it's a good thing nothing about this encounter has to make sense.

Unless... ?

[From [url=https://teamsnowcone.itch.io/pawcturne]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，一只奇怪的、摇摇晃晃的猫在你家门口叫。现在，这一切都是一个梦，所以这次相遇没有任何意义是一件好事。

除非…？

[来自[url=https://teamsnowcone.itch.io/pawcturne]itch.io[/url]]
